module: Flowgraph node "Set Fog" (category dynamic_instant). Sets the fog density (density, 0 to 1) and the fog atmosphere height (atmosphereHeight) via core_environment. When the graph starts it stores the current values and restores them on stop (data.restoreTod).
notes: The restore key is called restoreTod (copied from the Time of Day node).

postInit.desc: Configures the density pin as a 0 to 1 slider.

_executionStarted.desc: Stores the current fog density and height.

_executionStopped.desc: Restores the stored values if data.restoreTod is true.

work.desc: In repeat mode, applies the parameters every frame.

setFogParameters.desc: Calls core_environment.setFogDensity and setFogAtmosphereHeight with the pin values.
